title: Chosen derived presentation of a strict degree-two Ext class
statement: In an abelian category with Ext and a chosen derived category, ExtDerivedPresentation(S,H) consists of derived objects K,J, source:K≅single(S), target:J≅single(H)[2], and arrow:K→J. The Ext presentation equation is a separate predicate. This is actual endpoint and arrow data, not a chosen witness or an assertion about an Ext class.
